title: SCA Minhag of the Week 303: "Aleppo Customs of the month of Elul"

chapters.title: Introduction to Elul Minhagim
chapters.about: Overview of Elul customs and the Shulchan Aruch

chapters.title: History of Selihot in Aleppo
chapters.about: Mahzor Aram Soba and the 40-day period

chapters.title: Shofar and Mizmor 27
chapters.about: Clarifying community customs regarding shofar and Tehillim

chapters.title: Communal vs Private Practice
chapters.about: Distinguishing between individual and communal customs

summary: This class explores the traditional customs of the Aleppo community during the month of Elul. It examines the historical practice of reciting Selihot, the community's stance on blowing the shofar, and the recitation of Mizmor 27 from Tehillim.
questions: When did the Aleppo community traditionally recite Selihot?
Is it the custom of the Aleppo community to blow the shofar during Elul?
Should Mizmor 27 be recited communally after prayers during Elul?
What is the difference between private and communal minhagim?
